mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, member_id, target_amount, target_currency, target_baseline_amount, monthly_required_saving, created_at, updated_at FROM goal WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal (member_id, target_amount, target_currency, target_baseline_amount) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{targetAmount}, #{targetCurrency}, #{targetBaselineAmount}) AS newrow ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_amount = newrow.target_amount, target_currency = newrow.target_currency, target_baseline_amount = newrow.target_baseline_amount
